Application Data.NAME: Smith & Associates Tax Preparation Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Associates Tax Preparation Services specializes in providing comprehensive tax preparation and accounting services for individual clients and small businesses. Our operations include E-commerce transaction analysis, personalized financial reporting, and tax advisory services. We ensure strict compliance with IRS regulations and maintain a focus on client confidentiality and satisfaction. Our team is trained in data protection protocols and adheres to best practices in data security to safeguard sensitive information.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a data breach occurred due to unauthorized access to our client database, compromising sensitive client information. The breach was quickly contained, and clients were notified as per compliance regulations. The total cost incurred for remediation, including identity theft protection services for affected clients, was $5,000. The status of this incident is resolved, and we have since implemented stronger cybersecurity measures and staff training to prevent future occurrences.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• Business Operations: Confirm the exact nature of services provided. Firms engaged solely
in bookkeeping or tax preparation may have different risk profiles than those offering invest-
ment advice or financial planning.
• Professional Liability Coverage: Verify whether the applicant maintains separate pro-
fessional liability insurance. Absence of such coverage should prompt referral to a specialty
underwriter or require additional risk mitigation measures.
• Data Security Measures: Assess the firm’s cybersecurity protocols, including data en-
cryption, employee training, and backup systems. Strong controls reduce the likelihood and
impact of cyber incidents.
• Premises and Equipment Values: Ensure accurate valuation of office contents and prop-
erty to avoid underinsurance.
• Claims History: Review prior claims related to errors, omissions, data breaches, or general
liability incidents.
